description_footer:
🗺️ LAST MAP STANDING runs data-driven geographic, economic, and survival map simulations across all 50 U.S. states and 195 nations — Day 0 to Day 365 — until only one remains.

📊 Every episode uses real public energy, agriculture, elevation, coastline, water, and economic datasets rendered as animated vector cartography.

👇 Drop your state or country in the comments — did it survive this simulation?

Subscribe for daily Map Simulation Shorts and full 10-14 minute documentaries every 2 days.
